title: Prenatal Alcohol Exposure and Congenital Heart Defects: A Meta-Analysis.
authors: Yang J, Qiu H, Qu P, Zhang R, Zeng L, Yan H.
quote: Sensitivity analyses by removing of the poor-quality studies showed that the results did not change for the relationship between prenatal alcohol exposure and over- all CHDs (OR = 1.11, 95%CI = 0.88 -1.40), VSDs (OR = 1.13, 95%CI = 0.95 -1.33), CTDs (OR = 1.24, 95%CI = 0.97-1.59), or ASDs (OR = 1.40, 95%CI = 0.84 -2.35).
